function: CSI compression and feedback: CRNet autoencoder (UE encoder, BS decoder) updated online with elastic weight consolidation to keep accuracy on earlier scenarios (p. 2-4).
system: FDD massive MIMO-OFDM downlink, BS with 32 antennas, single-antenna UE, 72 subcarriers, 2 GHz carrier, 15 kHz spacing; no RIS (p. 1, 2, 4).
method: Convolutional autoencoder (CRNet) trained supervised with MSE offline, then fine-tuned online with an EWC-regularized loss (continual learning); model-transmission (MT-CL) and encoder-updating (EU-CL) variants (p. 3-4).
data_channel: 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-A, CDL-C, CDL-D generated in MATLAB; per scenario 5,000 offline, 500 online-update, 2,000 test samples; UE speeds 4.8-60 km/h (p. 4).
test_conditions: Offline training on CDL-C; online updating on scenario sequences C-D-A and C-A-C with 500-sample sets; performance then tested on all three scenarios, CR=4 and 16 (p. 4).
baselines: Learned only: multi-task learning (MTL) upper bound trained on all scenarios and the online-learning (OL) baseline of [9]; no codebook or other non-learned method compared (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE in dB per scenario, after each update and over the update sequence; parameters, transmission overhead, and training time (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table III: parameters 2.103M (UE) and 1.054M (BS), same as baseline; training time 29 s MT-CL, 20 s EU-CL, 18 s OL, RTX 2080S GPU (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The clustered delay line (CDL) channel model formulated in 3GPP TR38.901 [13] is utilized for evaluation".
q2_support: p. 4: "with the model offline trained in the CDL-C scenario. After that, the model encounters these scenarios in the sequence C-D-A and updates online every time a new scenario is encountered"; update set "500 for online updating dataset data".
q3_support: p. 4: "the multi-task learning (MTL) method [15] is used as the upper bound" and "the online learning strategy in [9] is selected as the baseline" are both learned. Missing: any non-learned method (codebook feedback appears only in the introduction, p. 1).
q4_support: p. 5: "the results are tested with 50 epochs and CR=4 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080S GPU"; Table III gives parameters (2.103M UE, 1.054M BS) and training time (29 s, 20 s, 18 s).
